content.title: How to watch Diamondbacks vs. Mets: TV channel and streaming options for April 7
content.text: The New York Mets aim to continue their three-game winning streak when they meet the Arizona Diamondbacks on Tuesday at 4:10 p.m. ET, at Citi Field. Freddy Peralta (1-0, 4.35 ERA) gets the start for the Mets, who are 6-4 this season and second in the NL East. Zac Gallen (1-1, 3.60 ERA) is expected to start for the Diamondbacks, who are 5-5 and second in the NL West.How to watch Arizona Diamondbacks vs. New York Mets Venue: Citi Field Time: 4:10 p.m. ET Streaming: Fubo (Stream now) TV: SNY and Dbacks.TV Watching in person?
